description:
FILED s518e (Opus 5.5, 2026-10-18) from the Type-Tiny census: "Can't locate object method "explain" via package "Error::TypeTiny::Assertion"" -- 9 PARTIAL files in chunk 1 and 3 of the 21-file sample (every failed type assertion's to_string calls $e->explain).

REPRODUCER (perl 5.40.3 vs main ff4c1500, also an old main 5c5a5679 -- pre-existing):

    package E; sub new { bless {}, shift }
    sub explain { "ex" }
    package main; print E->new->explain, "\n";

perl: `ex`.  PCL: dies "Can't locate object method "explain" via package "E"".  The same for `note`, `diag`, `is`, `ok`, `pass`, `plan` (probed, all six die).  `sub push` works (the runtime's push is p-push, no clash).

MECHANISM (measured): the TAP layer exports pl-ok / pl-is / pl-explain ... from :pcl (cl/pcl-runtime.lisp defpackage, "exported eagerly so user packages inherit pcl::pl-ok"), and every user package uses :pcl.  The reader reads `(p-sub pl-explain ...)` in package E as the INHERITED pcl::PL-EXPLAIN; %p-reserve-sub-name shadows in the symbol's HOME package (pcl -- a no-op) and interns there, so the install REDEFINES pcl::pl-explain (Test::More's explain is clobbered program-wide) and %pcl-own-method-symbol's `(eq (symbol-package sym) pkg)` never sees a method in E.

FIX SHAPE (NOT done -- it touches the sub-name mechanism every generated package goes through, and perl-tests/t/test.pl defines several of these names in main, so it needs the sweep + a companion --all --quick): %p-reserve-sub-name shadows in *package* when NAME is a pcl symbol INHERITED there (find-symbol status :inherited), and p-sub's %%perl-name / %%home-pkg read the reserved local symbol, not ',name.  Check the fasl path (the install re-reserves at load with *package* set by in-package) and whether test.pl's main::ok etc. are MEANT to replace the TAP layer's functions (then main must keep today's behaviour).


=== DONE (s519b) ===
Commit e8aea587 (the install): `%p-sub-name-home` -- a :pcl symbol the package only INHERITS is reserved (shadowed) in the package, so `sub explain` in package E defines E::pl-explain and no longer REDEFINES the TAP layer's explain program-wide.  Guard Pl/t/method-name-clash-01.t rows 1-3 (fail on fca3593b).
The s520 sweep found the install-time reservation came too late: perl-tests/anonsub.t 7 -> 1 rows -- test.pl's run_multiple_progs (line 293) read `run_perl` before test.pl's own definition (line 485) shadowed it, so it called the harness's dying stub; `package E; sub a { explain() } sub explain {}` called Test::More's explain.  FIX c5976a50: every sub the file DEFINES is declared `(p-declare-sub NAME :body)` at its section head (Pl::Parser::declare_sub_form, one spelling for the three emitters), which reserves the name before any caller is read; a bodyless `sub ok ($@);` reserves nothing.  FIX a08e001e: a qualified definition written in another package carries its qualifier, `(p-declare-sub E::pl-explain :body :E)` (`sub E::explain` in main now defines E's sub; on fca3593b `E->explain` found no method).  Guards method-name-clash-01.t rows 4-6.  Gen v2-6886.  ir-spec §5.1.
Bars: gate PASS (see s519b report), sweep GATE clean TOTAL 18,748 (+0; anonsub.t back to 7/3), corpus-diff 68 of 111 files differ, EVERY changed line = a p-declare-sub gaining `:body` (72 with a qualifier keyword), silent drops 5; emission-ab lib 39 DIFF / 16 SAME / 0 RCDIFF, the same token only.
Residue FILED #3430: a STRING-EVAL definition of a :pcl-exported name is not seen by code compiled before the eval.
subject: A user sub named like a Test::More function (ok, is, pass, plan, note, diag, explain, skip, like, fail ...) is NOT found as a METHOD of its class -- p-sub defines the inherited pcl::pl-NAME (clobbering the TAP layer's own) instead of a symbol in the class package; Error::TypeTiny::Assertion->explain
